title: rdp: add support for clipboard and audio out channels
description:
This patch adds basic parsing for audio out and clipboard redirection, only the
kind of message is parsed, not the complete body, but that already gives some
useful information.

notes.body:
Can you fix this (clang) warning :

```
packet-rdp_cliprdr.c:109:2: warning: Value stored to 'offset' is never read [deadcode.DeadStores]
packet-rdp_snd.c:104:2: warning: Value stored to 'offset' is never read [deadcode.DeadStores]
```

can you always this warning ?

` epan/dissectors/packet-rdp.c hf_rdp_flagsPkt filter= rdp.flags.pkt  - mask with non-contiguous bits SEC_PKT_MASK ( 0x4c1 )`
